# Grow your business with us

Leading manufacturer of lime, limestone and mineral-based product, we provide reliable supply and
help our customers to optimize their processes, improve safety, and reduce their carbon footprint.

[Discover our solutions][235]
[carmeuse-eu]

## Join our team

We are not just a company. We are a global family of 6300 employees all connected by a strong sense
of purpose.

Ready to join an organization where everyone can grow while being supported every step of the way?

[Discover who we are][236]

## Solutions to meet your business needs

Carmeuse is an industry leader, not only with the variety of lime and limestone products we offer,
but also with the customized equipment and engineering solutions we provide for your plant, storage,
and product transfer needs.

At Carmeuse, our people make the difference and partner with you. We focus on your specific needs

[Learn More][20]
[About Eagle Materials] [Eagle Materials LLC]
Fairborn Cement Company LLC

## [ Cement ][21]

Cement is the basic binding agent used to bind water, aggregates, and sand in the production of
ready mix concrete. Cement is used principally for public infrastructure, commercial construction,
and residential construction.

[][22]

## [ Gypsum Wallboard & Recycled Paperboard ][23]

Due to its inherent fire resistance, gypsum wallboard, commonly known as drywall, is the premier
building material for wall, ceiling, and partition systems in residential, institutional, and
commercial structures.

Our recycled paperboard, primarily used as the facing paper to produce gypsum wallboard, is produced
from 100% recycled paper.

[][24]

## [ Aggregates & Concrete ][25]

Aggregates are a granular material consisting of crushed stone, sand and gravel, manufactured to
specific sizes, grades, and chemistry for use primarily in construction applications. 

Ready mix concrete is a versatile, low-cost building material used in almost all construction.

[][26]

We engage in the business of **extracting raw marble **from the quarry and supply to our customers.

## Who Are We

### About Us

GCCP Resources Limited was listed on SGX since 2015. Our Group is principally engaged in the
business of quarrying and the processing of Marble from our GCCP Marble Quarry (formerly known as
Hyper Act Quarry). Our business operations are principally located in Simpang Pulai, Ipoh, Perak,
Malaysia.

[Read More][35]

### GCCP Marble Quarry

The GCCP Marble Quarry has a total acreage of 80 acres and has a mining elevation ranging from 50
meters to 400 meters. The GCCP Marble Quarry is situated in the Keramat Pulai Quarry Zone. Access to
the GCCP Marble Quarry is through a main public access road. As of 31 December 2019, the quarry had
a total Mineral Resource of 210 million tons, with combination of 55 million tons Measured Mineral
Resource, 150 million tons Indicated Mineral Resource and 8 million tons Inferred Mineral Resource.

[Read More][36]

## What We Produce

### Marble

GCCP Marble Quarry (Formerly known as Hyper Act Quarry) will be penetrating into the marble industry
as well, where the marble from GCCP Marble Quarry is mainly ivory white in colour. Besides from the
ivory white marble, GCCP Marble Quarry also have marble with grey and black vein, with different
patterns which can serve for different purposes, such as table top or wall decorations. The
production capacity of raw marble is expected to be 5,000 tons per month in the first phase of
production and shall increase gradually over the years.

The target recovery rate for raw marble block at GCCP Marble Quarry is expected to be 20% and the
leftover (marble waste) will be processed into GCC-grade Limestone for the calcium carbonate
industry.

[Read More][37]

Board and a member Audit, Nominating and Remuneration Committees.

Executive Director & Chief Executive Officer

Charles Loo begun his career as an Operations Trainee of the Company from 1 December 2014 to 30 June

Pay Cher Wee was appointed to the Board on 1 March 2016 and is the Chairman of the Audit Committee
and a member Nominating and Remuneration Committees.

## Who Are We

### About Us

GCCP Resources Limited was listed on SGX since 2015. Our Group is principally engaged in the
business of quarrying and the processing of Marble from our GCCP Marble Quarry (formerly known as
Hyper Act Quarry). Our business operations are principally located in Simpang Pulai, Ipoh, Perak,
Malaysia.

[Read More][35]

### GCCP Marble Quarry

The GCCP Marble Quarry has a total acreage of 80 acres and has a mining elevation ranging from 50
meters to 400 meters. The GCCP Marble Quarry is situated in the Keramat Pulai Quarry Zone. Access to
the GCCP Marble Quarry is through a main public access road. As of 31 December 2019, the quarry had
a total Mineral Resource of 210 million tons, with combination of 55 million tons Measured Mineral
Resource, 150 million tons Indicated Mineral Resource and 8 million tons Inferred Mineral Resource.

[Read More][36]

## What We Produce

### Marble

GCCP Marble Quarry (Formerly known as Hyper Act Quarry) will be penetrating into the marble industry
as well, where the marble from GCCP Marble Quarry is mainly ivory white in colour. Besides from the
ivory white marble, GCCP Marble Quarry also have marble with grey and black vein, with different
patterns which can serve for different purposes, such as table top or wall decorations. The
production capacity of raw marble is expected to be 5,000 tons per month in the first phase of
production and shall increase gradually over the years.

The target recovery rate for raw marble block at GCCP Marble Quarry is expected to be 20% and the
leftover (marble waste) will be processed into GCC-grade Limestone for the calcium carbonate
industry.

# At the core of what works

[
Get to know Lhoist
][4]
Get to know Lhoist

## At Lhoist, we provide lime, dolime, and mineral-based solutions that drive progress worldwide.

We partner with our customers and we deliver critical solutions across various [industries][5]. From
treating [drinking water][6] and [stabilizing soils][7] to [reducing emissions][8] and supporting
demanding industrial processes, our [products][9] support demanding operations that must perform
consistently.  

[
Learn more about us
][10]
[Expert in action_one man with a screen]

## Partner with Lhoist

We combine deep operational [expertise][11] with dependable, high‑performing solutions that perform
where it matters - in the real‑world conditions our customers face every day. Our products are
engineered to meet the specific demands of critical operations and applications. Beyond supply, we
also provide hands‑on [technical support][12] and reliable logistics services to help optimize
performance and efficiency.

[
Explore our solutions
][13]

## Learn more about the industries we support

[Expert at work _US]

## Join Lhoist to create lasting impact

At Lhoist, you [join teams][14] who take responsibility for keeping critical operations running, day
after day. Across our many roles, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills, solve real
challenges on the ground, and contribute to solutions that support industries and communities over
the long term. Step in and help build the reliability our future depends on.

[
Start your journey with us
][15]

## Key Figures

130+

sites and terminals

2

R&D centers

>80

country sales reach

6,400+

employees around the world

## Lhoist around the world

With a presence in 20+ countries with 130+ sites, we are close to our customers, delivering
reliability and expertise. 

[
See where we operate
][16]

## Our markets (sales by market)

32% Sales by market doughnut chart. Steel, 32 percent. Currently selected.
Steel Flue Gas Treatment Roads and Civil Engineering Water Treatment Building materials Agriculture
Pulp and Paper Non-ferrous metallurgical processing
At the core of what works.  

## Who we are

Our [lime][17], [dolime][18], and mineral solutions enable clean [water][19], stable soils,
[steel][20] under pressure, and renewable energy - where reliability matters every single day. 
Founded in 1889 and still family-owned, we combine long-term vision with hands-on expertise to meet
evolving needs. 
With 6,400+ people across 20+ countries, 130+ sites, and 80+ country sales reach, we stay close to
customers to secure supply and ensure continuity when it counts. 
Guided by respect, integrity, and courage, we work on site with operators, anticipating issues,
adapting to conditions, and creating lasting value through strong partnerships. Our teams deliver
the insight and support that keep performance steady and consistently.

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

#### Have a Look at Our New GMP Plant Situated at Manjusar, Vadodara, Gujarat.

Welcome to Annexe, where innovation meets excellence in pharmaceutical and food manufacturing. Our
brand-new FDA-GMP facility represents the pinnacle of cutting-edge technology and precision.
Equipped with an in-house GLP-certified laboratory and R&D facility, we ensure meticulous quality
control and pioneering advancements in every product.

Our 3000 MT/year manufacturing facility, nestled at the heart of the chemicals industry, offers an
ideal environment for innovation and collaboration. With a 30-ton HVAC system and 3-micron filtered
air, we maintain optimal conditions for hygiene and production. Trusted by over 400 industry
leaders, Annexe stands as a symbol of reliability and top-tier quality. Join us in revolutionizing
pharmaceutical and food production, setting new industry standards in the pursuit of excellence.

We take pride in offering a high-quality selection of Pharma Excipients & APIs. Our commitment to
excellence extends beyond manufacturing to advanced packaging techniques, ensuring product
integrity.

## Global Certifications. Trusted Quality.

Annexe Chem is a certified manufacturer, trusted by industries that demand precision and compliance.
We’re proud to be FSSC 22000 certified, aligning with global food safety standards, along with
practices that ensure batch traceability, documentation readiness, and audit-friendly operations.

As a leading supplier of high-purity chemicals, Annexe Chem serves leading manufacturers across the
pharmaceutical, food, and research sectors. Our product portfolio is engineered to meet the demands
of strict industry regulations and the expectations of those who won’t settle for less than
consistent quality. Whether you’re sourcing for large-scale production or precise formulation, our
food-grade, pharma-grade, and lab-grade chemicals are backed by purity, traceability, and global
standards.

# Expert in high-value treatment of
# Calcium Carbonate

Providing with green, high-value calcium carbonate ultrafine grinding, classifying and powder
coating processes.

## How does ALPA define
## “Green and High-value” of calcium carbonate?

##### Green

Dry process, no emissions of three wastes; airtight negative pressure, no dust leakage and noise
pollution; automation, intelligence and networking; it can realize high-value utilization of solid
waste and tailings, recommending with the matched equipment according to requirements. Responding to
changes in environmental protection and labor.

##### High-value

Keep up with the needs of users for transformation and upgrading, providing with high value-added
products based on material science. For mineral powder processing, the focus should be on particle
size and distribution, shape, purity, dispersibility and surface modification and coating.
Therefore, the processing technology should be selected based on its mineralogical composition and
structural characteristics.

## Calcium Carbonate Processing Technology

The wide application of calcium carbonate has prompted end users in the industry to continuously
develop new products. It has become a development trend to replace expensive raw materials with
calcium carbonate. Therefore, all walks of life have put forward higher requirements for calcium
carbonate products. Calcium carbonate processing equipment is also facing new challenges at any
time, its process has therefore become important area of ALPA technology research and development.

[https://caco3.alpapowder.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Classifying_and_Ball_Mill_Production_Line_w
orking_principle1.mp4][23]
[https://caco3.alpapowder.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Powder_coating_and_surface_modification_pro
duction_line_working_principle.mp4][24]

## Project cases

###### [A company in Heilongjiang produces 20,000 tons calcium carbonate classifying and ball mill
###### production line][25]

###### [A mineral factory in Benxi produces 50,000 tons calcium carbonate classifying and ball mill
###### production line][26]

###### [A mineral factory in Jilin produces 50,000 tons calcium carbonate classifying and ball mill
###### production line][27]

###### [A company in Baoxing, Sichuan Province, produces 40,000 tons calcium carbonate classifying
###### and ball mill production line][28]

###### [A mineral factory in Hubei produces 20,000 tons calcium carbonate classifying and ball mill
###### production line][29]

###### [An annual output of 30000 tons of calcium carbonate classifying and ball mill production
###### line of a company in Chizhou, Anhui Province][30]

###### [A powder company in Guangxi produces calcium carbonate vertical mill with secondary
###### classification production line][31]

###### [A chemical company in Foshan produces 30000 tons of d97:8-25micron calcium carbonate turbo
###### mill surface modification production line][32]

[MORE PROJECT CASES][33]

## About ALPA

ALPA focus on R&D of calcium carbonate ultra-fine and ultra-pure pulverization and classification,
powder shape control and selective pulverization, powder surface modification and powder industry
solutions. We independently researched and developed grinding mills and air classifiers that are
widely used in the production of ultrafine powders of non-metallic minerals such as calcium
carbonate, talc, marble, etc., which have greatly promoted technological progress and industrial
upgrading in the fields of minerals and new materials.

Countless small leaps accumulate into huge strides of ALPA’s growth. ALPA dares to innovate and
pursue excellence. After 20 years of steady development, ALPA has become a high-tech enterprise
integrating R&D, production, sales and service, a leader in the field of ultra-fine powder
technology research and powder equipment system integration in China, has made great achievements in
the international market.

# Expert in high-value treatment of
# Calcium Carbonate

Providing with green, high-value calcium carbonate ultrafine grinding, classifying and powder
coating processes.

## How does ALPA define
## “Green and High-value” of calcium carbonate?

##### Green

Dry process, no emissions of three wastes; airtight negative pressure, no dust leakage and noise
pollution; automation, intelligence and networking; it can realize high-value utilization of solid
waste and tailings, recommending with the matched equipment according to requirements. Responding to
changes in environmental protection and labor.

##### High-value

Keep up with the needs of users for transformation and upgrading, providing with high value-added
products based on material science. For mineral powder processing, the focus should be on particle
size and distribution, shape, purity, dispersibility and surface modification and coating.
Therefore, the processing technology should be selected based on its mineralogical composition and
structural characteristics.

## Calcium Carbonate Processing Technology

The wide application of calcium carbonate has prompted end users in the industry to continuously
develop new products. It has become a development trend to replace expensive raw materials with
calcium carbonate. Therefore, all walks of life have put forward higher requirements for calcium
carbonate products. Calcium carbonate processing equipment is also facing new challenges at any
time, its process has therefore become important area of ALPA technology research and development.

orking_principle1.mp4][23]

duction_line_working_principle.mp4][24]

###### classification production line][31]

###### mill surface modification production line][32]

[MORE PROJECT CASES][33]

## About ALPA

ALPA focus on R&D of calcium carbonate ultra-fine and ultra-pure pulverization and classification,
powder shape control and selective pulverization, powder surface modification and powder industry
solutions. We independently researched and developed grinding mills and air classifiers that are
widely used in the production of ultrafine powders of non-metallic minerals such as calcium
carbonate, talc, marble, etc., which have greatly promoted technological progress and industrial
upgrading in the fields of minerals and new materials.

Countless small leaps accumulate into huge strides of ALPA’s growth. ALPA dares to innovate and
pursue excellence. After 20 years of steady development, ALPA has become a high-tech enterprise
integrating R&D, production, sales and service, a leader in the field of ultra-fine powder

# Expert in Ground Calcium Carbonate(GCC) grinding, Classification and Modification

Provide process solutions and equipment

## For grinding, classification, modification, spheroidization and other processes of ground calcium
## carbonate (GCC)

Suitable for materials with calcium carbonate as the main component.Including calcite, limestone,
marble, chalk, micrite, white marble, coral, eggshell, seashell and so on.
[][60]

## A Comprehensive Analysis of Core Processes for Ground Calcium Carbonate Powder (GCC) Processing

Full Process from Coarse Crushing, Grinding to Modification, Creating Cost-Effective Industrial
Fillers

### [Preliminary Crushing][61]

#### [Break large raw ore lumps into small particles][62]

Calcium carbonate coarse crushing is the first step in the deep processing of calcium carbonate ore.
Large-particle-size raw ore is fed into coarse crushing equipment such as jaw crushers, and crushed
into small-particle materials with uniform particle size that meet the feeding requirements of
subsequent fine grinding processes. Common coarse crushing equipment features a simple structure,
stable operation and high crushing ratio, making it suitable for the large-scale processing of
calcium carbonate ore.
[Continue browsing Preliminary Crushing][63]

### [Grinding & Classification][64]

#### [Grinding to a sufficient fineness with precise screening][65]

After coarse crushing, the particles enter specialized equipment such as ball mills and are ground
to 1-10 microns by grinding media. Meanwhile, an air classifier is used for separation based on the
different settling velocities of the particles, ultimately producing qualified products with uniform
particle size that directly meet downstream processing standards.
[Continue browsing Grinding & Classification][66]

Caltron Clays & Chemicals Pvt Ltd is No.1 Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Raw Material manufacturers and
suppliers in India. Caltron Clays is an ISO 9001 Certified & CRISIL rated company, the only of its
kind in the minerals industry. Caltron Clays is a recognized export house specializing in the
processing and export of mineral, oxide, and chemicals.

## About Caltron

CALTRON is proudly celebrating its 26th year of successful operations having established a strong
reputation as a world-class manufacturer of natural calcium sources. Over the years, the company has
earned the trust of global customers through its unwavering commitment to quality innovation and
excellence.

Caltron proudly holds an extensive range of internationally recognized certifications including ISO
9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 18001, HACCP, HALAL, KOSHER, VEGAN, ECOCERT ORGANIC, SMETA 4 Pillar,
WHO-GMP compliance and DUNS registration. These certifications reflect the company’s dedication to
maintaining the highest standards across quality safety sustainability and ethical business
practices.

Guided by its tagline A Compliment to Supplement Caltron continues to deliver premium-quality
natural ingredients to customers worldwide. With its corporate office located in Mumbai India and a
state-of-the-art manufacturing site in India, the company serves a diverse range of industries with
natural mineral sources and natural cosmetic ingredients tailored to evolving market needs.

Caltron Clays & Chemicals Pvt Ltd is No.1 Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Raw Material manufacturers and
suppliers in India. Caltron Clays is an ISO 9001 Certified & CRISIL rated company, the only of its
kind in the minerals industry. Caltron Clays is a recognized export house specializing in the
processing and export of mineral, oxide, and chemicals.

[View Our Products][10]

## About Caltron

CALTRON is proudly celebrating its 26th year of successful operations having established a strong
reputation as a world-class manufacturer of natural calcium sources. Over the years, the company has
earned the trust of global customers through its unwavering commitment to quality innovation and
excellence.

Caltron proudly holds an extensive range of internationally recognized certifications including ISO
9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 18001, HACCP, HALAL, KOSHER, VEGAN, ECOCERT ORGANIC, SMETA 4 Pillar,
WHO-GMP compliance and DUNS registration. These certifications reflect the company’s dedication to
maintaining the highest standards across quality safety sustainability and ethical business
practices.

Guided by its tagline A Compliment to Supplement Caltron continues to deliver premium-quality
natural ingredients to customers worldwide. With its corporate office located in Mumbai India and a
state-of-the-art manufacturing site in India, the company serves a diverse range of industries with
natural mineral sources and natural cosmetic ingredients tailored to evolving market needs.

minerals, and animal feed supplements.

Our major market encompasses Caribbean, South/West Africa, North Europe, Middle East, South/West
Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America.

9

Caltron was visualized by Mr. S.N. JAIN the Managing Director of the company who molded the success

## Focusing On High-content & High-fineness Calcium Compounds For 40 Years

Changshu Hongyu was founded in 1984, we mainly produce calcium oxide, calcium hydroxide and other
products, the daily production of 200 tons, the products are exported to the world famous chemical
enterprises. 
Adopting new technologies to produce industrial, chemical, and petroleum additives for lime products
such as calcium hydroxide and calcium oxide, which are highly welcomed by users. We have our own
mine in Hubei Province and invest in a New company in 2023: Carlison New Materials (Jingshan) Co.,
Ltd. It covers an area of 20000 square meters.
The new company focuses on the production of fine chemical, medical, food grade calcium oxide,
calcium hydroxide products.As a leading supplier of calcium in China, we provide comprehensive
support to our customers in various fields.Through our professional sales team, extensive supplier
network, and strong market share, we are able to provide high-quality one-stop services.

# About Farayand Powder

More than 30 years of experience under our belt has made us one of the main leaders in micronizing
various types of mineral substances. We have more than 20 active lines involved in producing and
micronizing different kind of powders such as coated & uncoated calcium carbonate, talc, barite,
natural and synthetic red iron oxide as well as natural yellow iron oxide, industrial soot, etc.
which are widely used in various industries such as pharmaceutical, food, chemical, cosmetic,
health, drilling, petrochemical, polymer, paper, paint, pigment, ceramic and tile industries.

“Farayand Powder Alvan Co.”, is also considered as one of the pioneers in micronizing powder
industry of Iran and thanks to our well-experienced management team, we are the first and oldest
manufacturer of calcium carbonate that obtained the national standard certificate and seal of Iran.

Insurance Information

## **Architects Professional Liability Insurance Built for Design Risk**

Design professionals face a unique set of risks that extend far beyond construction completion.
Claims may arise from design interpretations, coordination challenges, or evolving client
expectations years after a project is delivered. Fenner & Esler provides architects professional
liability insurance designed to address these long-tail exposures while aligning coverage with how
architectural firms actually operate.

As an independent insurance broker, we evaluate multiple carriers and policy structures to ensure
architects receive coverage that reflects project scope, firm size, and contractual obligations
rather than relying on generic policy templates.

### **Professional Liability Insurance for Engineers Across Disciplines**

Engineering firms face heightened scrutiny due to the technical nature of their work and the
downstream impact of design decisions. Professional liability insurance for engineers must be
carefully structured to account for discipline-specific risks, including civil, mechanical,
electrical, and structural engineering services.

Fenner & Esler works closely with engineering firms to ensure coverage keeps pace with expanding
services, new project types, and changing regulatory requirements, providing long-term protection
rather than short-term fixes.

### **Independent Broker Advantages for Architects and Engineers**

Choosing an independent broker provides meaningful advantages when securing engineer professional
liability insurance or architectural coverage. Because Fenner & Esler is not tied to a single
insurance carrier, we focus on objective analysis and tailored recommendations instead of predefined
products.

This independence allows us to:
* Compare multiple policy forms and carriers
* Negotiate terms aligned with your contracts
* Adjust coverage as your firm evolves
* Provide unbiased guidance during claims

Our role is to act as an advocate for your firm, not a representative of an insurance company.

### **Insurance for Architects and Engineers Beyond Professional Liability**

While professional liability is critical, many firms require broader protection. Fenner & Esler
helps firms structure insurance for architects and engineers that integrates general liability,
cyber liability, and employment practices coverage into a cohesive risk management strategy.

Coordinated coverage reduces gaps and conflicts between policies, helping firms avoid unexpected
exclusions during a claim.

### **Errors and Omissions Insurance for Architects Explained**

Allegations of professional negligence can arise from missed details, coordination challenges, or
differing interpretations of design intent. Errors and omissions insurance for architects is
structured to respond to these claims while accounting for the realities of design-build
environments and multi-consultant projects.

Proper policy language and limits are essential to ensure coverage aligns with contractual
responsibilities and client expectations.

### **Liability Insurance for Engineers That Matches Contractual Risk**

Engineering contracts often impose strict liability standards and indemnification clauses. Liability
insurance for engineers must be reviewed in conjunction with these agreements to ensure coverage
responds appropriately if a claim occurs.

Fenner & Esler helps engineers understand how policy terms interact with contracts, reducing the
risk of uncovered exposures.

### **Surveyors and Environmental Consultants Insurance**

At Fenner & Esler, we don’t just specialize in architects & engineers insurance, but also provide
services for environmental consultants and surveyors. If you’re a surveyor or environmental
consultant, your options for insurance have most likely, up until now, been very limited. You may be
overpaying for or going without this coverage because you’ve been unable to find a plan that offers
exactly what you need and nothing more. Fenner & Esler is proud to offer the solution to this
problem, with flexible and reasonable coverage you can trust. We provide Errors & Omissions
surveyors insurance at reasonable rates that are flexible to your needs. This type of liability
insurance is highly important to your company as a whole, and to your surveyors, since it will
protect your assets in the case of a lawsuit resulting from negligence or professional mistakes.
Surveyor’s insurance should cover all financial damages incurred in this type of scenario, including
legal defense.

### **Architect Insurance and Engineer Insurance with Long-Term Support**

Whether you are a sole practitioner evaluating architect insurance or a growing firm reassessing
engineer insurance, Fenner & Esler provides guidance grounded in decades of experience serving
design professionals. Our goal is to help engineers and architects move forward with confidence,
supported by insurance programs built for both current projects and future growth.


#### Get A Quote

We're more than just brokers. We're A/E specialists, delivering the right coverage and exceptional
value and service to hundreds of design firms of all sizes. Of course we leverage the latest
industry resources to provide you with coverage, risk management and contract review tailored to
your practice. But we also remember the difference between simply billing clients and actually
serving them. See for yourself. Contact us of a competitive quote on your professional liability
insurance.

[Read More »][43]

#### Professional Liability Articles

* [Reducing Your Professional Liability Costs][45]
* [Contract Warranty][46]
* [Unintended Consequences in Green Design][47]
* [Insurance for IPD][48]
* [The Problem with "Duty to Defend" Provisions][49]

#### Apply For Coverage

It pays to have the right professional liability coverage. But you shouldn’t overpay. Or pay for
coverages you don’t need. Especially in this economy. There’s a better solution. Professional
liability insurance coverage for architects, engineers, and surveyors tailored for your business by
Fenner & Esler. We’re more than just brokers. We’re specialists serving the Built Environment. Since
1923, we’ve helped design firms of all sizes keep a tight rein on overhead by delivering the right
mix of coverage and value.

[Read More »][50]

  The Ultimate Guide to Sourcing Mica Powder in Bulk for Industrial Use Finding a reliable supplier
  for mica powder in bulk is a critical decision for manufacturers in the plastics, cosmetics, and
  construction industries. Muscovite mica, known for its exceptional thermal stability and chemical
  resistance, serves as a versatile mineral filler that enhances the physical properties of
  countless end-products. Whether you are looking to improve the electrical strength of a polymer or
  add a sophisticated shimmer to a cosmetic coating, understanding the nuances of mica processing is
  key to achieving consistent quality.

  Understanding Mica in Sand: Properties and Industrial Significance In the world of mineralogy and
  industrial materials, the presence of mica in sand is a critical factor that determines the
  suitability of the material for various applications. Mica, known for its layered structure and
  exceptional thermal stability, can significantly alter the physical and chemical properties of
  sandy deposits. Whether it is naturally occurring or synthetically introduced, understanding how
  mica interacts with silica-based aggregates is essential for manufacturers in the electronics,
  cosmetics, and construction industries. This guide explores the technical nuances of mica-sand
  compositions and why high-purity synthetic alternatives are often preferred in modern
  manufacturing.

  ][73]

  Industrial Properties and Impact of Mica in Quartz Minerals
  Understanding Mica in Quartz: Properties, Impact, and Industrial Value In the world of
  non-metallic mineral products, the geological composition of raw materials determines the quality
  of the final output. One of the most critical mineral interactions found in nature is the presence
  of mica in quartz . While quartz is prized for its hardness and chemical stability, the inclusion
  of micaa group of silicate minerals known for their layered structurecan significantly alter the
  physical and chemical properties of the stone. Whether you are in the construction industry,
  specialized ceramics, or high-end architectural design, understanding how these two minerals
  coexist is essential

  The Ultimate Guide to Using Mica in Cosmetic Formulations In the ever-evolving world of beauty and
  personal care, the demand for ingredients that provide both aesthetic appeal and functional
  stability is higher than ever. The use of mica in cosmetic products has become a cornerstone for
  formulators seeking to create a luxurious, shimmering effect. From high-end eyeshadows to daily
  skincare creams, this natural mineral offers an unparalleled ability to reflect light and improve
  product texture. Understanding the specific properties of mica allows manufacturers to optimize
  the visual impact and skin-feel of their products.

# Discovering what's possible with calcium

##### MLC is a world-class producer of calcium products including quicklime, hydrated lime, and
##### calcium carbonate . For over 100 years, MLC has been producing products from one of the
##### richest limestone reserves in the world and today supplies product throughout North America
##### and the world from over twelve plants and terminals.

[Learn More][149]

# Your Partner in Lime Solutions

##### When your work depends on minerals as essential as lime, you need a partner who delivers
##### consistency and confidence. Discover why MLC is the trusted choice for lime solutions that
##### deliver exceptional quality, reliability, and service.

[Learn More][150]

# Discovering what's possible with calcium

##### MLC is a world-class producer of calcium products including quicklime, hydrated lime, and
##### calcium carbonate . For over 100 years, MLC has been producing products from one of the
##### richest limestone reserves in the world and today supplies product throughout North America
##### and the world from over twelve plants and terminals.

[Learn More][149]

# Your Partner in Lime Solutions

##### When your work depends on minerals as essential as lime, you need a partner who delivers
##### consistency and confidence. Discover why MLC is the trusted choice for lime solutions that
##### deliver exceptional quality, reliability, and service.

** Welcome to GRRBE **

**GRRBE" **** **[Global Research Review in Business and Economics (GRRBE)][48] is a Referred,
Online, [Open Access,][49] Peer Reviewed, [DOI indexed][50] and [High Impact journal][51]. Global
Research Review in Business and Economics (GRRBE) ISSN (Print) 2395-4671, ISSN (Online) 2454-3217 is
an open access peer review bi-monthly research journal that publishes articles in the field of
education, business, and economics. The journal serves as a bridge between worldwide scholars and
education, business, and economics researchers. The journal publishes research articles and papers
in all areas of education, business, and economics. The journal aims to provide the most complete
and reliable source of information on recent developments in business studies. Each issue brings you
critical perspectives and cogent analyses, serving as an outlet for the best theoretical and
research work in the field. The purpose of the journal is to further the understanding of the theory
and practice of business studies by publishing articles of interest to practitioners and scholars.
The Journal is published in English. The e-journal provides free and open access to all of its
content on our website.

The journal is devoted towards broadcasting of knowledge related to the "Global Research Review in
Business and Economics" in the present world. The Journal is started with noble effort to help the
researchers in their work and also to share knowledge and research ideas. It publishes only
outstanding and quality works done by the researchers. It provides rapid publication and Open-Access
facility. All the submissions will be peer-reviewed by the panel of experts associated with a
particular field. Submitted papers should meet the internationally accepted criteria, and
manuscripts should follow the style of the journal for the purpose of both reviewing and editing.

## Who We Are

Gulshan Polyols Ltd is India’s leading manufacturers of Ethanol/Bio-fuel, Grain and Mineral based
specialty products with three decades of experience. Our business portfolio broadly spans across
three main segments, viz. grain processing, bio-fuel / distillery and mineral processing operations
that allow us to produce specialty products such as starch and starch derivatives including
sorbitol, calcium carbonate, ethanol (bio-fuel), country liquor, agro based animal feed.

GPL has accelerated its expansion plan in both existing and new geographies, emphasizing growth
potential in the Indian bio-ethanol space. Our theme - Expanding Potential, underpins our focus
strategies and demonstrates our commitment to a sustainable tomorrow.

expectations by keeping them updated on our products and services. We also welcome feedback from our
valued customers in order to meet all their needs.

At Heliopolis we are committed to protecting the environment and green spaces, We believe that
preserving the environment and the continuation of green life is one of the most important issues
that concern us. Our goal is to reduce the negative impact and preserve it in every commodity or
service we provide.

applications to serve our customers quickly, efficiently, and effectively. This facilitates customer
service and access to our products electronically through the application of smart phones without
the need for traditional methods.

our strict adherence to international quality management standards. According to these standards,
quality is subject to an audit and examination process that is strict. Quality control is an
integral part of the quality management system at Heliopolis.

## From EGYPT, Minya’s
## to Global Markets

**Minya **is one of the most important limestone regions in the world. The area’s unique geological
formation provides calcium carbonate of high brightness, low impurities, and excellent chemical
stability. **HERBOCAL **was founded with a clear vision — to harness these natural resources
responsibly and deliver consistent, high-quality minerals to global industries.

From raw material extraction to advanced processing and micronization, **HERBOCAL **manages the
entire supply chain with precision and care, ensuring that every product leaving our facility meets
the highest international standards.

## What We
## Offer

**HERBOCAL **specializes in a wide range of calcium carbonate grades, tailored to meet the diverse
needs of our clients:
* Ground Calcium Carbonate (GCC): micronized powders with controlled particle sizes.
* Coated Calcium Carbonate (Stearic Acid Coated): engineered for enhanced dispersion in plastics,
  rubber, and adhesives.
* High-Brightness Grades: for paper, paint, and coating industries requiring superior whiteness.
* Customized Solutions: developed in close collaboration with clients to achieve optimal performance
  in end-use applications.

## Industries
## We Serve

**HERBOCAL’s calcium carbonate** products are essential in a wide array of industries. Here are all
the sectors we support, with expanded applications:
* Plastics & PVC — improving rigidity, processing, surface finish, and cost-efficiency.
* Paints & Coatings — brightness, opacity, easy spread, durability, optimized rheology.
* Paper & Packaging — enhanced whiteness, opacity, printability, smoother finish.
* Rubber & Elastomers — reinforcement, wear resistance, tear strength.
* Construction Materials — concrete, mortar, tiles, sealants, adhesives; as filler / extender.
* Adhesives & Sealants — viscosity control, bonding strength, stability.
* Food & Beverage — food additive (E170), calcium fortifier, anticaking, pH/acidity regulation.
* Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare — dietary calcium supplements, antacids, excipients.
* Animal Nutrition / Feed — calcium for bone and egg health, feed supplement.
* Glass & Ceramics — raw materials; flux; enhancing whiteness, refining structure.
* Environmental Applications — wastewater treatment, neutralizing acidity, flue gas
  desulphurization, soil remediation.
* Cosmetics & Personal Care — mild abrasives (e.g. for toothpastes), texturizers, pH control.

## Why HERBOCAL?

[✔] High-purity calcium carbonate from Minya’s world-class deposits

[✔] Full control over extraction, grinding, and coating processes

[✔] Customizable grades for diverse applications

[✔] Reliable export logistics from Egypt to the world

[✔] Commitment to quality, sustainability, and long-term partnerships

## Quality
## You Can Trust

**At HERBOCAL, **quality control is at the core of everything we do. Every batch undergoes strict
testing for particle size distribution, brightness, chemical purity, and moisture content. Our
facilities operate with modern grinding and coating technology to ensure consistency and
performance.

**HERBOCAL **adheres to ISO-certified production processes, international safety standards, and
sustainable resource management practices. By continuously investing in technology and training, we
ensure our clients receive calcium carbonate products that exceed expectations.

## Global Reach

**HERBOCAL** is not only a trusted supplier in Egypt but also a recognized exporter of calcium
carbonate to markets worldwide. Our strategic location in Minya allows us to efficiently ship from
Alexandria Port, ensuring reliable logistics and timely delivery to international partners.

Our growing network of distributors and clients across the Middle East, Africa, Europe, and Asia
reflects our reputation for reliability, quality, and long-term partnerships.

Who is Himachal Polyolefins Ltd (Himpol)?

Himachal Polyolefins Ltd (Himpol) is a leading manufacturer of **calcium carbonate** products,
including **Precipitated Calcium Carbonate (PCC)**, **Ground Calcium Carbonate (GCC)**, **Direct

industries such as **oral care (dentifrice) & cosmetics,** **pharmaceuticals & nutraceuticals, food,
plastics, paints, adhesives, and more** with high-quality, certified solutions.

What industries do you serve?

Himpol’s calcium carbonate products are widely used across a variety of industries, including:
* **Oral Care (Dentifrice/Toothpaste)**
* **Cosmetics & Personal Care**
* **Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals**
* **Food & Beverages**
* **Plastics & Rubber**
* **Paints & Coatings**
* **Sealants & Adhesives**
* **Paper & Printing**
* **Veterinary & Animal Feed**
* **Construction Materials**
* **Glass Manufacturing**

What products do you manufacture?

We specialize in:
* **Precipitated Calcium Carbonate (PCC):** High-purity, customizable formulations.
* **Ground Calcium Carbonate (GCC):** Cost-effective, versatile solutions for industrial
  applications.
* **Direct Compressible (DC) Grade Calcium Carbonate:** For pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, and
  veterinary tablets or capsules.
* **Food Grade Calcium Carbonate (FCC):** Safe and certified calcium carbonate for food and beverage
  applications.
* **Fine Calcium Carbonate: **High purity calcium carbonate with fine particle size distribution.
* **Limestone:** Limestone coarse powder with low iron for specialized applications.
* **Dolomite: **Dolomite coarse powder with low iron for specialized applications.

* **Halal Certified**
* **Kosher Certified**

products for a global market.

# We Are Leading Industrial Minerals Manufacturer & Supplier.

We are Mine Owners and the leading producer and supplier of Talc, Calcium Carbonate (both GCC &
PCC), China Clay, Kaolin, Calcined Kaolin, Dolomite, Feldspar, Quartz, Bentonite, Roasted Bentonite,
Hydrated Lime, Quick Lime, Bleaching Clay, Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate, Aluminium Sulphate,
Sodium Silicate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Mg/Ca/Zn Stearate, Sodium Chloride, PVD
Salt, Paraffin Wax, Shea Butter, Petroleum Jelly and other non-metal industrial minerals. We cater
to a wide range of industries including Food, Pharma, Cosmetic, Home and Personal Care, Paint &
Coating, Ink, Adhesives, Plastic Compounding, Rubber, Ceramic, Feed, Agriculture and more. HTMC
Group is at the forefront of driving growth and innovation in the mineral sector as one of the Top
Manufacturers of Minerals in India.

[
][29]

## About
## HiTech Minerals and Chemicals Group

HTMC is engaged in manufacturing, processing, distributing, and exporting Natural minerals like
talc, Dolomite, Calcium carbonate, Feldspar, Calcite so on to varied industries such as Food Pharama
Automotive, Agriculture, Construction, Iron &Steel, Paints & Coating etc. As premier [**Mineral
Manufacturers in India**][30], HTMC Group specializes in procuring, processing, and supplying a
comprehensive array of industrial minerals. As one of the top industrial distribution companies in
India, we specialize in processing, manufacturing, and supplying a wide range of non-metallic
mineral products to meet the diverse needs of our clients.

We are the undisputed leading source of minerals and chemicals -
* 40+ years of experience
* Complete technical Compliance with certifications.
* US-DMF Registered Manufacturing Facility
* 3-In house internationally accredited Labs
* Global footprint in 39+ countries
* Purity of our minerals

Our mission is to become that one big player in a highly fragmented industry through increased
aggregation, catering to industry wide customers through JIT supply chains to optimise cost by
employing our considerable and cvolving technical, manufacturing and logistics capabilities. Our
vast network and strategic partnerships enable us to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique
needs of [Mineral Based Industry][31] across India.As a trusted bulk mineral supplier, HTMC Group
offers a wide range of minerals in large quantities. Our efficient supply chain ensures timely
delivery and competitive pricing for our clients.At HTMC Group, we take immense pride in being a
leading force in the Indian industrial mineral landscape. We transcend the limitations of simply
being mineral processors in India

[ Products][32] [ Enquire Now][33]

## Why
## HiTech Minerals and Chemicals Group
* Our complete focus to satisfy our clients with high end products has conferred upon us huge
  accolades and an extensive customer support in market. HTMC has emerged as the leading industrial
  mineral company,catering to diverse sectors with its extensive range of products and unparalleled
  serviceThe whole range is manufactured at our own production site with the incorporation of ultra
  modern technology and incomparable skills of our team leading to the development of outstanding
  range that fits to diverse needs of our clients.
* 
* 
* Manufacturer of Minerals in India: We source premium raw materials and meticulously process them
  into high-performance industrial minerals.
* Bulk Mineral Suppliers in India: We cater to the large-scale needs of various industries, ensuring
  a consistent and reliable supply of essential minerals.
* Mineral Distributors: Our extensive network allows us to deliver our products efficiently to
  clients across India.

everyone deserves honest feedback, recognition and opportunities to grow. Huber’s culture is built
for inclusion and empowerment, encouraging our employees to achieve individual and team goals.

ranging from expanding technical skills to professional and leadership development. We help our
employees grow by empowering them with accountability from the earliest stages of their careers. At
some locations, promising talents can even take advantage of apprenticeships, internships, and
cooperative education programs to get a great start in the working world.

# WE ARE PERFORMANCE MINERALS

### SPECIALIZING IN THE PRODUCTION AND DISTRIBUTION OF HIGH QUALITY GROUND CALCIUM CARBONATES

## ABOUT INCOA PERFORMANCE MINERALS

INCOA Performance Minerals supplies fine, ultrafine and treated ground calcium carbonate for North
American markets. Our high-quality ground calcium carbonate can be used as a functional filler in a
variety of end-products including film, fiber, pipe, conduit, vinyl profile used in construction,
paint, sealant, caulk, adhesive, and rubber. 

We offer a unique and highly pure starting mineral that provides customers with a new option for all
their ground calcium carbonate needs.

[ Learn More ][48]

### QUALITY

Our team understands the importance of quality. That’s why we’ve engineered our products and
developed processes with quality at the heart of  everything we do.

The exceptional purity of the high-brightness limestone we use provides a unique starting material
 for our InCal products. In addition,  our patent-pending process does not include the use of
processing chemicals that  can interfere with application performance. The resulting products are
characterized by:
* Low levels of acid insoluble minerals
* High purity
* Steep particle size distributions
* Low levels of oversize particles and agglomerates
* Low levels of ultrafine particles

### PERFORMANCE

Our product offering and  internal processes put customer needs front and center. By focusing on
these needs, we strive to design products fit-for-use based on customer needs.

### EXPERTISE

We are an industrial minerals manufacturing and logistics company with a full suite of fine,
ultrafine and treated ground calcium carbonates.  We leverage our years of experience to provide
consistently high-quality products and services.  With a depth of experience in mining,
international operations, research, product development, engineering, industrial processing,
logistics, quality management, customer service, sales, and marketing, we are well-suited to deliver
outstanding products to your plant.

### BEST-IN-CLASS

Our exceptionally pure limestone is just the first step in the manufacture of our innovative
products. Our patent-pending processing coupled with our laser-like focus on quality and our
understanding of major technical and logistical drivers allow us to create a Best-in-Class
experience for our customers.

Theodore, AL 36582

### Span

A calculated value that describes the breadth of the particle size distribution by looking at the
size of the particle below which 90% of all particles are found (d90), the median and the size of
the particle below which 10% of all particles are found (d10).

**The Span is calculated from the following equation:**


**Where:**
d90 = particle size below which 90 % of the particles are described
d10 = particle size below which 10% of the particles are described
d50 = particle size below which 50% of the particles are described, also known as the median

*Broader distributions have a larger span while narrower distributions have a smaller span.*

### Level of Ultrafines

**The percentage of the total distribution that includes particles that are 0.5 microns or
smaller.**

Some demanding applications require careful control of the level of very small particles. These
particles can make the powder difficult to disperse and can actually absorb important components of
formulations ultimately altering end-use performance.

### Topcut

**The size below which 100% of the particles can be found.**

Unlike most ground calcium carbonate suppliers, INCOA specifies at the 100% passing rather than the
industry standards of 95% or 98% passing. We recognize that even very low levels of oversize
particles can interfere with the performance of our products in your applications

### Median

**The size below which 50% of the particles can be found.**

This is the most common means of describing the size of ground calcium carbonate powders. INCOA
describes our medians on the final product as-received by our customers. This means that the
specification testing is performed on samples of the shipment before shipment on the final product
not on material still in-process.

### Span

A calculated value that describes the breadth of the particle size distribution by looking at the
size of the particle below which 90% of all particles are found (d90), the median and the size of
the particle below which 10% of all particles are found (d10).

**The Span is calculated from the following equation:**


**Where:**
d90 = particle size below which 90 % of the particles are described
d10 = particle size below which 10% of the particles are described
d50 = particle size below which 50% of the particles are described, also known as the median

*Broader distributions have a larger span while narrower distributions have a smaller span.*

### Level of Ultrafines

**The percentage of the total distribution that includes particles that are 0.5 microns or
smaller.**

Some demanding applications require careful control of the level of very small particles. These
particles can make the powder difficult to disperse and can actually absorb important components of
formulations ultimately altering end-use performance.

### Topcut

**The size below which 100% of the particles can be found.**

Unlike most ground calcium carbonate suppliers, INCOA specifies at the 100% passing rather than the
industry standards of 95% or 98% passing. We recognize that even very low levels of oversize
particles can interfere with the performance of our products in your applications

### Median

**The size below which 50% of the particles can be found.**

This is the most common means of describing the size of ground calcium carbonate powders. INCOA
describes our medians on the final product as-received by our customers. This means that the
specification testing is performed on samples of the shipment before shipment on the final product
not on material still in-process.

## About Innova Corporate (India)

**Innova Corporate (India)** is a pioneer in the new era of technology, providing world-class
products in **Polyelectrolyte, Sodium Meta Bi Sulphite, and Ferric Chloride Anhydrous**. As we cater
to the industrial and municipal needs of **India**, we specialize in delivering advanced solutions
for ETP, STP, and R.O. systems. Our presence in **India** is dedicated to supporting the city's
world-famous leather, footwear, and tourism sectors with high-performance chemical formulations and
strategic industrial supply.

Our mission in **India** is to empower local industries through innovative chemical technology and
sustainable water treatment practices. We provide the essential technical backbone for the city's
manufacturing units, ensuring high-quality industrial operations that meet global standards. At
Innova Corporate, we are proud to be a strategic partner in **India** industrial progress, offering
everything from water purification media to specialized industrial chemicals for the entire region.

Founded by dynamic entrepreneur **Mrs. Nisha Agarwal** and inspired by CEO **Mr. Vinod Kumar
Agarwal**, we bridge technical innovation with decades of experience globally.

OUR APPROACH

## What we don't promise

We produce minerals, compound engineering polymers, and source commodity resin. Here is what each of
those commitments cannot guarantee.

### We match grades. We don’t promise the first candidate grade passes.

A specification match is a starting point, not a production guarantee — the proof happens on your
line, with your data. For engineering polymers, our engineers adjust the formulation until your part
qualifies, and you commit only after it passes.

### We verify documents. We don’t eliminate customs risk.

We check for HS code mismatches, Form E errors, and cross-document inconsistencies before shipping.
But customs authorities make final decisions, and regulations change without notice.

### We tell you when we don’t know.

If we haven’t shipped a grade before, we say so. If a spec match looks marginal, we flag it. If the
pricing doesn’t justify the switching cost, we’ll tell you that too.

The gap between a datasheet and a production floor is real. Our job is to close it with better
information and the honesty to tell you when we can't.

OUR APPROACH

## What we don't promise

We produce minerals, compound engineering polymers, and source commodity resin. Here is what each of
those commitments cannot guarantee.

### We match grades. We don’t promise the first candidate grade passes.

A specification match is a starting point, not a production guarantee — the proof happens on your
line, with your data. For engineering polymers, our engineers adjust the formulation until your part
qualifies, and you commit only after it passes.

### We verify documents. We don’t eliminate customs risk.

We check for HS code mismatches, Form E errors, and cross-document inconsistencies before shipping.
But customs authorities make final decisions, and regulations change without notice.

### We tell you when we don’t know.

If we haven’t shipped a grade before, we say so. If a spec match looks marginal, we flag it. If the
pricing doesn’t justify the switching cost, we’ll tell you that too.

The gap between a datasheet and a production floor is real. Our job is to close it with better
information and the honesty to tell you when we can't.

# Industrial Minerals, Extenders and Additives Supplier, Processor and Distributor

Kish Company has long-standing relationships with our suppliers and regularly wins best distributor
awards. We source the [best materials][22] from around the globe and [warehouse them locally][23],
so that you can rest easy knowing that supply is on hand.

As well as distribution, Kish has extensive manufacturing capabilities enabling us to deliver custom
solutions that give our customers an edge. Whether you need tailored particle size distribution,
surface treatments, “quartz free” products or low moisture, we have you covered. And if your current
supplier takes a grade off the market and leaves you in a bind – come to us and we will create a
drop-in replacement for you.

Our internal lab is set up not only for rigorous QC testing but also for new product development. We
pride ourselves on being large enough to supply the *Fortune 100* but nimble enough to deliver
[outstanding new products][24]. In the last few years alone, we have delivered new minerals and
technologies that are the envy of the industry.

۱خاستگاه

## خاستگاه معدن

ماد‌کوهزاد عملیات خود را از انتخاب دقیق ذخیره معدن کلسیت پایدار آغاز می‌کند، نه از هر معدنی. پیش از
شروع استخراج، تیم زمین‌شناسی ما با نمونه‌برداری شبکه‌ای و آنالیز آزمایشگاهی مغزه‌های حفاری، نقشه‌ی دقیقی
از توزیع خلوص CaCO₃ در عمق و سطح معدن ترسیم می‌کند تا فقط بلوک‌هایی با خلوص پایدار و بالا (معمولاً بالای
۹۸ درصد در منشأ) شناسایی و علامت‌گذاری شوند. این انتخاب اولیه، پایه‌ی تمام مراحل بعدی است: محصولی که از
سنگ نامناسب شروع شده باشد، در هیچ مرحله‌ای از فرآوری قابل اصلاح کامل نیست. به همین دلیل، خریداران
صنعتی ما همان ثبات کیفی را در محموله‌ی اول و محموله‌ی صدم نیز تجربه می‌کنند.

۱خاستگاه۲استخراج۳خردایش۴آسیاب۵مهندسی محصول۶آزمایشگاه۷تحویل
برای حرکت بین مراحل اسکرول کنید

درباره ماد‌کوهزاد

## اعتماد را در هر تن مهندسی می‌کنیم.

ماد‌کوهزاد عملیات معدن‌کاری سنگ‌آهک و واحدهای فرآوری مواد معدنی را با استانداردهای کیفی بین‌المللی اداره
می‌کند. ما کربنات کلسیم با خلوص بالا را به تولیدکنندگانی عرضه می‌کنیم که هیچ‌گونه نوسان کیفی را
نمی‌پذیرند؛ از کارخانه‌های ترکیب PVC تا فرموله‌کنندگان رنگ. عملیات ما برای یک هدف طراحی شده است: کیفیت
معدنی قابل پیش‌بینی، قابل گواهی و قابل صادرات، در هر محموله.

### عملیات کنترل‌شده معدن

ذخایر سنگ‌آهک شناسایی‌شده زمین‌شناسی با درصد CaCO₃ پایدار، استخراج‌شده تحت پروتکل‌های دقیق.

### فرآوری در سطح مهندسی

خطوط خردایش چندمرحله‌ای و آسیاب دقیق برای تولید مش‌بندی‌های کالیبره از ۲۰۰ تا ۳۵۰۰.

### کنترل کیفیت آماده صادرات

هر بچ پیش از ترخیص از نظر خلوص، درجه روشنایی و رطوبت آزمایش می‌شود و مستندات کامل ارائه می‌گردد.

### ظرفیت لجستیک منطقه‌ای

آمادگی برای تحویل فله و بسته‌بندی‌شده به اربیل، سلیمانیه، بغداد و بازارهای گسترده‌تر منطقه.

اعتبار فنی

## مشخصات محصول — کربنات کلسیم (CaCO₃)

## طراحی‌شده برای صنایعی که ثبات می‌خواهند.

### صنعت PVC

کربنات کلسیم درجه پرکننده برای لوله، پروفیل و ترکیبات PVC.

### رنگ و پوشش

پودر با درجه روشنایی بالا برای کنترل گستردگی و مات‌کنندگی.

### صنعت کاغذ

گریدهای مش ریز برای کاربردهای روکش و پرکننده.

### پلاستیک و مستربچ

اندازه ذرات دقیق برای فرمولاسیون حامل مستربچ.

### صنعت لاستیک

پرکننده تقویتی برای ترکیبات لاستیکی فنی و صنعتی.

### مواد ساختمانی

پودر سنگ‌آهک با گرید فله برای سیمان و محصولات ساختمانی.

### صنعت حفاری

کربنات کلسیم کالیبره‌شده برای کاربرد وزن‌دهی سیال حفاری.

ذخایر سنگ‌آهک شناسایی‌شده زمین‌شناسی با درصد CaCO₃ پایدار، استخراج‌شده تحت پروتکل‌های دقیق.

### فرآوری در سطح مهندسی

خطوط خردایش چندمرحله‌ای و آسیاب دقیق برای تولید مش‌بندی‌های کالیبره از ۲۰۰ تا ۳۵۰۰.

### کنترل کیفیت آماده صادرات

هر بچ پیش از ترخیص از نظر خلوص، درجه روشنایی و رطوبت آزمایش می‌شود و مستندات کامل ارائه می‌گردد.

### ظرفیت لجستیک منطقه‌ای

آمادگی برای تحویل فله و بسته‌بندی‌شده به اربیل، سلیمانیه، بغداد و بازارهای گسترده‌تر منطقه.

اعتبار فنی

## مشخصات محصول — کربنات کلسیم (CaCO₃)

پارامترهای کنترل‌شده آزمایشگاهی برای پودر کربنات کلسیم صنعتی.

──────────────────┬───────────────────────────
پارامتر           │مشخصات                     
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
خلوص CaCO₃        │٪۹۸.۰ – ٪۹۹.۵ ≥            
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
درجه روشنایی (ISO)│٪۹۲ – ٪۹۷                  
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
میزان رطوبت       │٪۰.۲ ≤                     
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
شاخص سفیدی        │+۹۰                        
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
وزن مخصوص فله     │۱.۳ – ۱.۵ گرم/سانتی‌متر مکعب
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
pH (محلول ۱۰٪)    │۸.۵ – ۹.۵                  
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────
جذب روغن          │۱۲ – ۱۸ گرم/۱۰۰گرم         
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────

برگه مشخصات نمونه. مستندات کامل گواهی‌شده به همراه هر محموله بر اساس درخواست ارائه می‌شود.

### ۱۲ گرید مش موجود — خلوص تا ٪۹۹.۵

از مش ۲۰۰ تا ۳۵۰۰، در دو خط ساده (بدون پوشش) و کتود (با پوشش اسید استئاریک).

**Quality Assurance
**
We have a separate quality control unit, equipped with advanced machinery and tools. For our
granules and masterbatches, we follow comprehensive quality control procedures, including testing of
procured raw materials to the finished products. We check every pigment and additive used in the
production of masterbatches and granules and make sure they are free from contaminants and meet the
specific colour specifications. Furthermore, we check the specifications of base polymers used in
the production of masterbatches. During the production stages, we check colour accuracy, dispersion
and other technical specifications of the products.

Our range of PVC pipes and conduit pipes undergoes various quality testing procedures such as
checking of the PVC resin used in the production of PVC pipes, and also checking the fillers and
additives used in the pipes. Our quality analysts monitor the extrusion and molding processes, to
ensure correct dimensions, and physical properties of products. We also conduct product testing
which includes checking products for impact resistance, tensile strength, water pressure, leakage
and others.

**Why Us?**

We always strive to fulfil the ever-changing requirements of clients, and have therefore implemented
a comprehensive quality control procedure. We adopt strict quality evaluation practices, starting
from the sourcing of raw materials to the final delivery of products. Our products such as Calcium
Carbonate Powder, PVC Masterbatches, Plastic Granules, and Conduit Pipes are 100% quality assured
are delivered to our clients within the time frame promised.

We have achieved a respectable position in the industry because of the following business traits:

* Assurance of premium quality products
* Wide distribution system for effective delivery of products
* Affordable price range

## **Our Product**

[Wet Grounded Calcium Carbonate; Calcium Carbonate Pigment Slurry (WGCC)]

### **Calcium Carbonate Pigment Slurry (WGCC)**

Wet Grounded Calcium Carbonate (WGCC) is extensively employed in various industries, notably in
paper manufacturing, duplex board production, and the paint sector. Its extremely fine particle size
and high brightness make it an outstanding pigment material, particularly for coatings in paper and
board. WGCC contributes significantly to improve the smoothness, gloss, and printability of the
coated paper & board. WGCC is used both as a base and an extender in paint Industry. This enhances
the paint by increasing its durability and opacity, making it a versatile component in improving
overall paint quality.

[ Learn more ][28]

[Precipitated calcium carbonate PCC]

#### On-Site PCC Projects

Precipitated Calcium Carbonate (PCC) is a versatile and high quality material widely used in various
industries. Known for its uniform particle size and pure composition, PCC enhances the performance
of products in paper making. Its unique properties contribute to improved brightness, opacity, and
surface finish, making it an essential component for manufacturers aiming to achieve superior
product quality. Additionally, PCC is an eco-friendly option, as it can be produced sustainably,
making it a preferred choice of paper filler through on-site PCC plant.

[ Learn more ][29]
[Grounded Calcium Carbonate; Calcite Powder]

#### GCC Projects

Grounded calcium carbonate (GCC) is a naturally occurring mineral derived from limestone or marble.
It is a white, odorless powder commonly used in various industries due to its versatility and
abundance. GCC is primarily used as a filler in the paper, plastic, rubber and paint industries,
enhancing the products properties and reducing production costs. In the paper industry, it improves
brightness, opacity, and surface smoothness of the paper. In plastics, it increases the durability
of the material. Its ecofriendly nature make grounded calcium carbonate a valuable resource in
modern manufacturing.

[ Learn more ][30]
[Wet Grounded Calcium Carbonate; Calcium Carbonate Pigment Slurry (WGCC)]

#### On-Site WGCC Projects

grinding naturally occurring limestone in a wet process. Known for its High brightness, opacity, and
smoothness, WGCC is widely used in paper filler & coatings, paint and adhesive industries to enhance
product quality and performance. It offers excellent dispersion, controlled particle size, and
consistent viscosity making it an essential functional filler for industries demanding precision and
reliability. WGCC contributes significantly to improve the smoothness, gloss, and printability of
the coated paper & board.

Meeting Global Demands With Expertise And Efficiency

# PETRO NAFT PETROLEUM PRODUCTS

Petroleum products play an essential role in our daily lives, powering transportation, heating
homes, fueling industries, construction and many other projects. From bitumen and Gilsonite to
chemical and petrochemical products, the demand for these resources continues to grow globally. As
the world population expands and economies develop, the need for petroleum products is only set to
increase.
To meet these growing demands, it is crucial to prioritize quality and efficiency in production.
High-quality products ensure the safe and reliable performance of infrastructure and machinery.
Quick supply is also vital to support ongoing projects and initiatives around the world.
Global distribution of petroleum resources also plays a critical role in meeting demand. With
resources spread across various regions, it is essential to work collaboratively to ensure fair
distribution and access for all. Effective logistics and transportation networks are key to
delivering petroleum products where they are needed most.
Petro Naft acknowledges the significance of meeting worldwide demands for petroleum products.
Emphasizing quality in production, the company endeavors to efficiently deliver products to clients
across the globe. With a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility, Petro
Naft aims to be at the forefront of the industry as a leader.

FULLY EQUIPPED

***A Trusted Global Partner in Petroleum Products & Technical Solutions***

With a strong foundation and a clear mission, we deliver reliable petroleum products and integrated
technical solutions to global markets.

We are a recognized producer and exporter of petroleum-based products, supported by advanced
manufacturing facilities, strategically located warehouses, and long-standing collaborations with
refineries, petrochemical plants, chemical producers, and mining operations worldwide. Our global
footprint spans key markets including the UAE, Turkey, China, and India, with major offices in
Turkey and the United Arab Emirates.

Driven by transparency, integrity, and mutual trust, we are committed to delivering consistent
quality and long-term value. Through our Engineering & Technical Services division, we provide
end-to-end solutions—from project planning and automation to system design and continuous
operational support—ensuring efficiency and reliability at every project stage.

## PRODUCTS

Petro Naft provides a comprehensive portfolio of high-performance industrial materials engineered to
support critical applications across infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and chemical industries.
Designed for reliability, efficiency, and compliance with international standards, our
solutions—from construction and waterproofing systems to advanced fluids, additives, and specialty
materials—enable durable performance, operational efficiency, and long-term value across global
markets.
[ LEARN MORE > ][25]

## SERVICES

Petro Naft delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for industrial projects worldwide, from system
design and automation to implementation and ongoing support. Leveraging deep technical expertise and
global experience, we provide scalable, reliable, and performance-driven solutions tailored to each
operation. Our commitment to engineering excellence ensures long-term value, efficiency, and
sustainability across every project.
[ LEARN MORE > ][26]

### Moving responsibly

Low-Carbon Operations

### Protecting people

Safe & Empowered Workforce

[esg ruls]

### Closing loops

Circularity & Resource Efficiency

### Powering progress

Collaborative Innovation

GLOBAL PETROLEUM INSIGHTS

Serves as a dedicated platform for delivering in-depth market analysis and strategic perspectives on
global oil prices, petroleum product markets, and key developments across the energy sector. This
section examines major price drivers, short- and long-term market trends, and the impact of economic
and geopolitical factors on global supply and demand, providing clear and actionable insights into
an evolving marketplace.

In addition to market intelligence, Global Petroleum Insights covers leading international
petroleum, oil, and gas exhibitions, highlighting industry innovation, emerging technologies, and
global networking opportunities. With a forward-looking and data-driven approach, this section acts
as a trusted resource for executives, investors, and industry professionals seeking informed
decision-making

Meeting Global Demands With Expertise And Efficiency

# PETRO NAFT PETROLEUM PRODUCTS

Petroleum products play an essential role in our daily lives, powering transportation, heating
homes, fueling industries, construction and many other projects. From bitumen and Gilsonite to
chemical and petrochemical products, the demand for these resources continues to grow globally. As
the world population expands and economies develop, the need for petroleum products is only set to
increase.
To meet these growing demands, it is crucial to prioritize quality and efficiency in production.
High-quality products ensure the safe and reliable performance of infrastructure and machinery.
Quick supply is also vital to support ongoing projects and initiatives around the world.
Global distribution of petroleum resources also plays a critical role in meeting demand. With
resources spread across various regions, it is essential to work collaboratively to ensure fair
distribution and access for all. Effective logistics and transportation networks are key to
delivering petroleum products where they are needed most.
Petro Naft acknowledges the significance of meeting worldwide demands for petroleum products.
Emphasizing quality in production, the company endeavors to efficiently deliver products to clients
across the globe. With a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility, Petro
Naft aims to be at the forefront of the industry as a leader.

FULLY EQUIPPED

***A Trusted Global Partner in Petroleum Products & Technical Solutions***

With a strong foundation and a clear mission, we deliver reliable petroleum products and integrated
technical solutions to global markets.

We are a recognized producer and exporter of petroleum-based products, supported by advanced
manufacturing facilities, strategically located warehouses, and long-standing collaborations with
refineries, petrochemical plants, chemical producers, and mining operations worldwide. Our global
footprint spans key markets including the UAE, Turkey, China, and India, with major offices in
Turkey and the United Arab Emirates.

Driven by transparency, integrity, and mutual trust, we are committed to delivering consistent
quality and long-term value. Through our Engineering & Technical Services division, we provide
end-to-end solutions—from project planning and automation to system design and continuous
operational support—ensuring efficiency and reliability at every project stage.

## PRODUCTS

Petro Naft provides a comprehensive portfolio of high-performance industrial materials engineered to
support critical applications across infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and chemical industries.
Designed for reliability, efficiency, and compliance with international standards, our
solutions—from construction and waterproofing systems to advanced fluids, additives, and specialty
materials—enable durable performance, operational efficiency, and long-term value across global
markets.
[ LEARN MORE > ][25]

## SERVICES

Petro Naft delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for industrial projects worldwide, from system
design and automation to implementation and ongoing support. Leveraging deep technical expertise and
global experience, we provide scalable, reliable, and performance-driven solutions tailored to each
operation. Our commitment to engineering excellence ensures long-term value, efficiency, and
sustainability across every project.
[ LEARN MORE > ][26]

  * [Our Team][88]
    Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our
    customers.
    
    Our people are the backbone of our business and offer a wealth of knowledge, advice and support
    to deliver what we promise when we promise.
  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.
  * [Community][91]
    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.
  * [Compliance][92]
    Responding to our customers’ needs and providing peace of mind.
    
    Implementation of the required control systems enable us to meet all regulatory compliance and
    legislation, ensuring the chemicals and services we provide to you achieve consistent standards
    and exceed your expectations.

[plater mini logo]

## Plater Group is a leading UK chemical supplier, providing high-quality chemical supplies,
## manufacturing services and bespoke solutions to a wide range of industries including
## pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, water treatment, coatings, construction and
## electronics.

As a trusted chemicals supplier, we combine global sourcing with advanced in-house capabilities such
as [chemical research and development][98], custom synthesis, [spray drying][99], [toll spray
drying][100], [spray cooling][101], [liquid][102] and [powder blending][103], toll manufacturing and
contract packaging. This integrated approach allows us to deliver consistent, compliant and
cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents
to specialised formulations, our expertise in chemical manufacturing and processing provides
customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage
