  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.

    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.

    Responding to our customers’ needs and providing peace of mind.

# Industrial chemical supplies and services for the UK and Ireland

### DISCOVER PLATER

[plater mini logo]

## Plater Group is a leading UK chemical supplier, providing high-quality chemical supplies,
## manufacturing services and bespoke solutions to a wide range of industries including
## pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, water treatment, coatings, construction and
## electronics.

As a trusted chemicals supplier, we combine global sourcing with advanced in-house capabilities such
as [chemical research and development][98], custom synthesis, [spray drying][99], [toll spray
drying][100], [spray cooling][101], [liquid][102] and [powder blending][103], toll manufacturing and
contract packaging. This integrated approach allows us to deliver consistent, compliant and
cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents
to specialised formulations, our expertise in chemical manufacturing and processing provides
customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage

Coated Calcium Carbonate
Coated Calcium Carbonate is a refined form of calcium carbonate that is treated with a surface
coating, typically stearic acid or other organic compounds. This coating enhances the material’s
properties, making it highly desirable for specific industrial applications. The coating improves
its dispersibility, hydrophobicity (water repellence), and compatibility with organic polymers,
making it particularly useful in industries such as plastics, paints, and rubber. [Learn more][6]
Uncoated Calcium Carbonate
Uncoated Calcium Carbonate is manufactured using cutting-edge technology to ensure uniform quality,
high whiteness, and tailored properties for various industries. Their expertise in producing
Uncoated Calcium Carbonate allows them to meet the specific requirements of sectors such as paper,
plastics, pharmaceuticals, and coatings, where performance and precision are critical. By offering
both precipitated and ground calcium carbonate, Shree Sai Calnates provides comprehensive solutions
for diverse industrial applications. [Learn more][7]

Sai Calnates Pvt. Ltd., major supplier of Calcium Carbonate in India
Sai Calnates Pvt. Ltd. is promoted by Mr. Parmesh Goyal and Mr. Sarthak Tibrewal. Sai Calnates Pvt.
Ltd. has today established itself as a major supplier of Calcium Carbonate both Coated and Uncoated
in India since 1999. Starting with the modest capacity of 6000 MTPA today Sai Calnates has grown to
the capacity of 1,20,000 MTPA. Today Sai Calnates has a Sound, Satisfied and prestigious customer
base who in their own right are major players in the application they represent.

Established with the vision to deliver premium calcium carbonate solutions, the company has quickly
grown into a trusted name in the market. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and customer
satisfaction sets us apart as a leader in the industry. Our products find extensive applications in
industries such as plastics, rubber, paints, paper, pharmaceuticals, and construction.
Coated Calcium Carbonate
Coated Calcium Carbonate is a refined form of calcium carbonate that is treated with a surface
coating, typically stearic acid or other organic compounds. This coating enhances the material’s
properties, making it highly desirable for specific industrial applications. The coating improves
its dispersibility, hydrophobicity (water repellence), and compatibility with organic polymers,
making it particularly useful in industries such as plastics, paints, and rubber. [Learn more][6]
Uncoated Calcium Carbonate
Uncoated Calcium Carbonate is manufactured using cutting-edge technology to ensure uniform quality,
high whiteness, and tailored properties for various industries. Their expertise in producing
Uncoated Calcium Carbonate allows them to meet the specific requirements of sectors such as paper,
plastics, pharmaceuticals, and coatings, where performance and precision are critical. By offering
both precipitated and ground calcium carbonate, Shree Sai Calnates provides comprehensive solutions
for diverse industrial applications. [Learn more][7]
For more details about Sai Calnates Pvt. Ltd. & our various Calcium Carbonate Products

* 2026/06/02 [Production Formula and Process Requirements for Rigid PVC Foaming Sheets][95]
  The Production Formula and Process Parameters for High-Quality Rigid PVC Foam Decorative Boards  
  Rigid PVC foam boards play a vital role in modern home decoration. So how are high-quality rigid
  PVC boards produced? Below, we have compiled a reference formula and process parameters for the
  production of rigid PVC foam decorative boards. Please note that adjustments should be made
  according to specific production conditions.   The Origin of Rigid PVC Foam Boards   The history
  of rigid PVC foam boards is relatively short. They were first developed in the 1970s, with
  industrial production truly taking off in the 1990s. Upon its emergence, this material was hailed
  as "the wood of the future." Its chemical composition is polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Rigid low-foam
  PVC products are extremely versatile and can replace almost all wood-based products, making them
  highly competitive with natural wood.   In recent years, rigid foam technology has developed
  rapidly. The United States, in particular, has made notable progress in rigid PVC foaming
  technology, with high investment and output, leading to the development of many innovative
  products. This has enabled the industrialization of rigid PVC foam products in the fields of
  building materials and furniture.   The processing technology for rigid PVC foam products has also
  advanced quickly. Whether in terms of equipment, molds, or formulation processes, all have met the
  requirements for foaming.   By adding wood powder or other fillers to PVC foam products, different
  properties can be achieved, broadening the application range of these products as substitutes for
  various construction and decorative materials. Additionally, rigid PVC foam products offer
  excellent surface decoration properties.   Compared with wood, rigid low-foam PVC materials are
  moisture-proof, anti-corrosive, insect-proof, flame-retardant, and require no painting. They are
  also non-toxic, odorless, and resistant to termites. These products not only save wood but also
  effectively improve living environments, making them the ideal indoor and outdoor building
  materials.   Beyond replacing wood, PVC low-foam materials can also substitute for other
  construction materials. Benefits include reduced raw material usage, resulting in lower product
  costs; lower thermal conductivity, improving insulation and heat retention; and reduced thermal
  expansion.   Today, PVC foam products are produced on a large scale, including rigid PVC free-foam
  and skin-foam solid boards, hollow boards, rigid PVC foam decorative profiles, pipes, and
  wood-plastic composites. Their applications are increasingly widespread in construction,
  packaging, and furniture industries.   Raw Material Requirements   PVC Resin: Grade 8 resin is
  commonly used due to its fast gelation speed, relatively low processing temperature, stable
  product quality, and easy density control. In recent years, many manufacturers have switched to
  Grade 5 resin.   Stabilizers: For environmentally friendly and effective stabilization, rare earth
  stabilizers are the first choice. However, due to their higher cost, they have not been widely
  adopted. As environmental regulations tighten, the future market for rare earth stabilizers looks
  promising. Calcium-zinc stabilizers present issues such as "zinc burning" and slightly lower
  stabilization efficiency, so they are used less frequently. Currently, lead salt stabilizers are
  the most widely used. Because foam boards have wide cross-section molds, long flow paths, and
  yellow foaming generates significant heat, stabilizers with high lead content and strong
  stabilization performance are required; otherwise, various product defects may occur.   Blowing
  Agents: The AC blowing agent releases a large amount of heat during decomposition, which can cause
  yellowing in the center of the cross-section. Therefore, a certain amount of white blowing agent
  should be added to absorb excess heat. The blowing agent should have a high mesh count to ensure
  uniform foaming without large bubbles.   Foaming Regulators: Through years of R&D and improvement,
  the technology for ACR foaming regulators has become increasingly mature, with stable performance
  and quality. For thin boards, regulators that promote rapid plasticization are recommended; for
  thick boards, regulators with slower plasticization but higher melt strength should be used.  
  Lubricants: A balance of initial, intermediate, and late-stage lubrication should be maintained to
  ensure that the material is protected by lubricants at all stages, allowing long-term stable
  production without precipitation or scaling.   Foaming Aids: A small amount of zinc oxide can be
  added to improve foam quality and cell structure. To reduce precipitation, a small amount of
  aluminum silicate may also be added.   Pigments:For enhanced aesthetics, titanium dioxide and
  optical brighteners can be added. To improve weather resistance, antioxidants and UV absorbers are
  recommended.   Fillers: Light calcium carbonate or heavy calcium carbonate can be used; activated
  calcium is not necessary. Fillers with a high mesh count are preferred.   We have done chemical
  products for over 30years. Our products include PVC RESIN, CPE, PE WAX, PARAFFIN WAX, STABILIZER,
  ACR, TIO2 and so on. One-stop purchase can save your time. Welcome inquiries:
  86-18539282682(wechat/whatsapp).

* 2026/06/02 [Production Formula and Process Requirements for Rigid PVC Foaming Sheets][95]
  The Production Formula and Process Parameters for High-Quality Rigid PVC Foam Decorative Boards  
  Rigid PVC foam boards play a vital role in modern home decoration. So how are high-quality rigid
  PVC boards produced? Below, we have compiled a reference formula and process parameters for the
  production of rigid PVC foam decorative boards. Please note that adjustments should be made
  according to specific production conditions.   The Origin of Rigid PVC Foam Boards   The history
  of rigid PVC foam boards is relatively short. They were first developed in the 1970s, with
  industrial production truly taking off in the 1990s. Upon its emergence, this material was hailed
  as "the wood of the future." Its chemical composition is polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Rigid low-foam
  PVC products are extremely versatile and can replace almost all wood-based products, making them
  highly competitive with natural wood.   In recent years, rigid foam technology has developed
  rapidly. The United States, in particular, has made notable progress in rigid PVC foaming
  technology, with high investment and output, leading to the development of many innovative
  products. This has enabled the industrialization of rigid PVC foam products in the fields of
  building materials and furniture.   The processing technology for rigid PVC foam products has also
  advanced quickly. Whether in terms of equipment, molds, or formulation processes, all have met the
  requirements for foaming.   By adding wood powder or other fillers to PVC foam products, different
  properties can be achieved, broadening the application range of these products as substitutes for
  various construction and decorative materials. Additionally, rigid PVC foam products offer
  excellent surface decoration properties.   Compared with wood, rigid low-foam PVC materials are
  moisture-proof, anti-corrosive, insect-proof, flame-retardant, and require no painting. They are
  also non-toxic, odorless, and resistant to termites. These products not only save wood but also
  effectively improve living environments, making them the ideal indoor and outdoor building
  materials.   Beyond replacing wood, PVC low-foam materials can also substitute for other
  construction materials. Benefits include reduced raw material usage, resulting in lower product
  costs; lower thermal conductivity, improving insulation and heat retention; and reduced thermal
  expansion.   Today, PVC foam products are produced on a large scale, including rigid PVC free-foam
  and skin-foam solid boards, hollow boards, rigid PVC foam decorative profiles, pipes, and
  wood-plastic composites. Their applications are increasingly widespread in construction,
  packaging, and furniture industries.   Raw Material Requirements   PVC Resin: Grade 8 resin is
  commonly used due to its fast gelation speed, relatively low processing temperature, stable
  product quality, and easy density control. In recent years, many manufacturers have switched to
  Grade 5 resin.   Stabilizers: For environmentally friendly and effective stabilization, rare earth
  stabilizers are the first choice. However, due to their higher cost, they have not been widely
  adopted. As environmental regulations tighten, the future market for rare earth stabilizers looks
  promising. Calcium-zinc stabilizers present issues such as "zinc burning" and slightly lower
  stabilization efficiency, so they are used less frequently. Currently, lead salt stabilizers are
  the most widely used. Because foam boards have wide cross-section molds, long flow paths, and
  yellow foaming generates significant heat, stabilizers with high lead content and strong
  stabilization performance are required; otherwise, various product defects may occur.   Blowing
  Agents: The AC blowing agent releases a large amount of heat during decomposition, which can cause
  yellowing in the center of the cross-section. Therefore, a certain amount of white blowing agent
  should be added to absorb excess heat. The blowing agent should have a high mesh count to ensure
  uniform foaming without large bubbles.   Foaming Regulators: Through years of R&D and improvement,
  the technology for ACR foaming regulators has become increasingly mature, with stable performance
  and quality. For thin boards, regulators that promote rapid plasticization are recommended; for
  thick boards, regulators with slower plasticization but higher melt strength should be used.  
  Lubricants: A balance of initial, intermediate, and late-stage lubrication should be maintained to
  ensure that the material is protected by lubricants at all stages, allowing long-term stable
  production without precipitation or scaling.   Foaming Aids: A small amount of zinc oxide can be
  added to improve foam quality and cell structure. To reduce precipitation, a small amount of
  aluminum silicate may also be added.   Pigments:For enhanced aesthetics, titanium dioxide and
  optical brighteners can be added. To improve weather resistance, antioxidants and UV absorbers are
  recommended.   Fillers: Light calcium carbonate or heavy calcium carbonate can be used; activated
  calcium is not necessary. Fillers with a high mesh count are preferred.   We have done chemical
  products for over 30years. Our products include PVC RESIN, CPE, PE WAX, PARAFFIN WAX, STABILIZER,
  ACR, TIO2 and so on. One-stop purchase can save your time. Welcome inquiries:

TIOXIN™ TiO2 (Rutile Grades) For Paint And Coating Applications

## TIOXIN™ TiO2 (Rutile Grades) For Paint And Coating Applications

TIOXIN™ Titanium Dioxide (TiO₂) has been designed for high-end paint and coating applications that
need high brightness, excellent opacity, and durable weatherability. Sukhmani Impex is a reliable
titanium dioxide supplier that delivers consistent quality for global industries. Learn more about
[Tioxin TiO2 Applications][14].

To find the right grade for your needs, download the [Grade Selection Guide][15].

### TIOXIN™ DR-2000

TIOXIN™ DR-2000 Titanium Dioxide offers extended durability in both brightness and weather
resistance, providing top-quality protection in the most demanding conditions.

### TIOXIN™ DR-2100

TIOXIN™ DR-2100 Titanium Dioxide provides outstanding dispersibility, superior hiding power, and
stable optical properties across high-end finishes for a wide range of coatings applications.

### TIOXIN™ DR-2200

TIOXIN™ DR-2200 Titanium Dioxide offers superior gloss retention, enhanced UV resistance, and
increased opacity across high-performance finishes,providing a broad range of applications in
demanding outdoor environments.

### TIOXIN™ DR-945

TIOXIN™ DR-945 Titanium Dioxide delivers superior dispersion properties, improved tinting strength,
and consistent colour performance across a variety of coating applications in a broad range of
industrial environments.

### TIOXIN™ DR-900+

TIOXIN™ DR-900+ Titanium Dioxide provides high brightness, excellent opacity, and strong weather
resistance in high-quality, durable coatings for interior and exterior use.

## TIOXIN™ TiO2 (Rutile Grades) For Plastics And Polymers

TIOXIN™ TiO₂ offers superior brightness, UV resistance, and color strength in plastics and polymers.
Engineered for long-lasting performance in both indoor and outdoor applications. Learn more about
[TIOXIN TiO₂ Applications][16].

To find the right grade for your needs, download the [Grade Selection Guide][17].

### TIOXIN™ DR-2400

Offers strong opacity, uniform particle dispersion, and appearance of consistent colour strength in
plastic and polymer compounds. It is made to perform consistently and stably in high-temperature
processing, as well as long-term durability in products.

### TIOXIN™ DR-2400+

This version offers brighter colours and improved blue undertones for higher whiteness tonality in
moulded plastic. The material provides exceptional resistance to UV exposure for a long-lasting
visual appearance, adaptable to indoor and outdoor applications.

### TIOXIN™ DR-2450

This product is characterised by excellent melt processing and high colour strength in polyolefin
and engineering plastic applications. It will provide excellent impact resistance and gloss
retention over time.

### TIOXIN™ DR-945+

This high-purity chloride TiO₂ offers excellent whiteness, weathering resistance, and optical
properties. It is an ideal choice in plastic applications where the highest UV stability and colour
consistency are needed.

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

Filler in carbonato di calcio

## La sostanza
## delle cose

“La natura è una sfera infinita il cui centro è ovunque e la circonferenza in nessun luogo”

*Blaise Pascal*

## minerale
## naturale

La terra è un luogo ricco di tesori:
il nostro si chiama carbonato di calcio. Questo materiale, presente in notevoli quantità, viene
estratto da Umbria Filler in giacimenti di calcare siti in Italia.

In seguito a tecniche di macinazione, selezione granulometrica e processi chimico-fisici, il
carbonato di calcio, assume caratteristiche che gli consentono di essere presente, come filler, in
oggetti, molti dei quali insospettabilmente comuni.

### I Nostri Stabilimenti

#### Nocera Umbra

Frazione Scalo, 96
06025 Nocera Umbra (PG)
Italy

#### Sulmona

Via Martiri delle Foibe
67039 Z.I. Sulmona (AQ)
Italy

## ciò che compone
## il tutto

Il CaCO3 completa la nostra realtà e dà corpo a prodotti quali vernici (lucide, satinate,
idrorepellenti), rivestimenti, piastrelle, impasti per la carta, plastiche, pvc, consentendo
l’abbassamento dei costi unitari formulativi e mantenendo intatte le caratteristiche finali del
manufatto. In alcuni casi, come per i settori edile e automotive, le peculiarità dei componenti
meccanici e dielettrici vengono esaltate dall’utilizzo del carbonato di calcio.

#### Automotive

Tutto il necessario per l’industria automobilistica.

#### Edilizia

Pitture, rivestimenti, sigillanti, finiture, pavimenti, vernici, finiture a spessore e giunti
elastici.

#### Materie plastiche & Masterbatches

Cavi elettrici, tubi, profili, film, fogli e profili infissi in Pvc.

#### Industria cartaria

Ottimizza le proprietà dei materiali cartacei.

#### Bio-Plastiche

Packaging e monouso biodegradabili.

## evoluzione &
## tecnica

**In simbiosi con la natura**,
anche noi evolviamo e cresciamo. Grazie al reparto Ricerca e Sviluppo, Umbria Filler, maturando
un’esperienza lunga 40 anni, è riuscita a trasformare le proprie competenze per adattarsi alle
richieste di mercato e a selezionare prodotti conformi a nuovi campi applicativi. Sono nati così i
**tecno-fillers**, frutto di una tecnologia produttiva innovativa e affinati in sinergia con le
esigenze del cliente.

### Tecno Fillers

La serie di filler d’avanguardia, sviluppata e realizzata da UmbriaFiller, ha un livello di
bianchezza altissimo, un’abrasività prossima allo zero e un aumento della resistenza meccanica

### Bio-Plastiche

Fillers altamente innovativi, destinati alle applicazioni su film, packaging, elementi monouso,
plastiche solide bio-based e bio-degradabili.

L’industria bioplastica ha una nuova pelle

## Bio Fill /
## Innovazione verde

**Ecologico, economico, sostenibile.**

**BioFill®** è una speciale varietà di carbonato di calcio (CaCO3) ottenuta mediante un **innovativo
trattamento superficiale** che lo rende performante nei compounds di **resine bio-plastiche** e nei
**poliesteri in generale** (PLA, ecc.).

**BioFill®** rappresenta un’alternativa economica ed ecologica per l’industria della bioplastica e
dei poliesteri: massima funzionalità tecnica, completa **Rinnovabilità e Riciclabilità nel Compost
industriale, assenza di fenomeni degradativi delle mescole (idrolisi delle catene polimeriche)**,
grande attenzione per l’ambiente. 

[Scopri di più][12]

**BioFill ®** è Food Contact

**BioFill ®** è Brevettato

**BioFill ®** è Rinnovabile

**BioFill ®** è Riciclabile

**BioFill ®** è Performante

## virtuosi di natura

UMBRIA FILLER si impegna da anni a garantire il rispetto delle norme internazionali in materia di
**Qualità, Salute, Sicurezza, Ambiente** e **Processi energetici**.

A tal fine ha conseguito le e Certificazioni per Sistemi di Gestione della Qualità ISO 9001,
ottenuti sin dal 1992, le Certificazioni Ambientali ISO 14001 per stabilimenti e cave, sin dal 1998
e la Certificazione Energetica ISO 50001.

Nel 2025 e 2026 Umbria Filler ha ottenuto, nel campo R&S e Sostenibilità Ambientale le
certificazioni:
**Ok Compost **da TUV Austria per la linea BioFill®  
**Certificazione di Prodotto con contenuto di materiale riciclato/recuperato/sottoprodotto** da ICMQ

### Umbria Filler
### *Rete Commerciale*

Umbria Filler segue il prodotto in tutto il suo ciclo di produzione e vendita: grazie allo sviluppo
di attività funzionali viene garantita al cliente completa assistenza, dalla scelta dei prodotti più
idonei, alla pianificazione logistica, fino alla gestione di utilizzo.

## La sostanza
## delle cose

“La natura è una sfera infinita il cui centro è ovunque e la circonferenza in nessun luogo”

*Blaise Pascal*

## minerale
## naturale

La terra è un luogo ricco di tesori:
il nostro si chiama carbonato di calcio. Questo materiale, presente in notevoli quantità, viene
estratto da Umbria Filler in giacimenti di calcare siti in Italia.

In seguito a tecniche di macinazione, selezione granulometrica e processi chimico-fisici, il
carbonato di calcio, assume caratteristiche che gli consentono di essere presente, come filler, in
oggetti, molti dei quali insospettabilmente comuni.

### I Nostri Stabilimenti

#### Nocera Umbra

Frazione Scalo, 96
06025 Nocera Umbra (PG)
Italy

#### Sulmona

Via Martiri delle Foibe
67039 Z.I. Sulmona (AQ)
Italy

## ciò che compone
## il tutto

Il CaCO3 completa la nostra realtà e dà corpo a prodotti quali vernici (lucide, satinate,
idrorepellenti), rivestimenti, piastrelle, impasti per la carta, plastiche, pvc, consentendo
l’abbassamento dei costi unitari formulativi e mantenendo intatte le caratteristiche finali del
manufatto. In alcuni casi, come per i settori edile e automotive, le peculiarità dei componenti
meccanici e dielettrici vengono esaltate dall’utilizzo del carbonato di calcio.

#### Automotive

Tutto il necessario per l’industria automobilistica.

#### Edilizia

Pitture, rivestimenti, sigillanti, finiture, pavimenti, vernici, finiture a spessore e giunti
elastici.

#### Materie plastiche & Masterbatches

Cavi elettrici, tubi, profili, film, fogli e profili infissi in Pvc.

#### Industria cartaria

Ottimizza le proprietà dei materiali cartacei.

#### Bio-Plastiche

Packaging e monouso biodegradabili.

## evoluzione &
## tecnica

**In simbiosi con la natura**,
anche noi evolviamo e cresciamo. Grazie al reparto Ricerca e Sviluppo, Umbria Filler, maturando
un’esperienza lunga 40 anni, è riuscita a trasformare le proprie competenze per adattarsi alle
richieste di mercato e a selezionare prodotti conformi a nuovi campi applicativi. Sono nati così i
**tecno-fillers**, frutto di una tecnologia produttiva innovativa e affinati in sinergia con le
esigenze del cliente.

### Tecno Fillers

La serie di filler d’avanguardia, sviluppata e realizzata da UmbriaFiller, ha un livello di
bianchezza altissimo, un’abrasività prossima allo zero e un aumento della resistenza meccanica

### Bio-Plastiche

Fillers altamente innovativi, destinati alle applicazioni su film, packaging, elementi monouso,
plastiche solide bio-based e bio-degradabili.

L’industria bioplastica ha una nuova pelle

## Bio Fill /
## Innovazione verde

**Ecologico, economico, sostenibile.**

**BioFill®** è una speciale varietà di carbonato di calcio (CaCO3) ottenuta mediante un **innovativo
trattamento superficiale** che lo rende performante nei compounds di **resine bio-plastiche** e nei
**poliesteri in generale** (PLA, ecc.).

**BioFill®** rappresenta un’alternativa economica ed ecologica per l’industria della bioplastica e
dei poliesteri: massima funzionalità tecnica, completa **Rinnovabilità e Riciclabilità nel Compost
industriale, assenza di fenomeni degradativi delle mescole (idrolisi delle catene polimeriche)**,
grande attenzione per l’ambiente. 

[Scopri di più][12]

**BioFill ®** è Food Contact

**BioFill ®** è Brevettato

**BioFill ®** è Rinnovabile

**BioFill ®** è Riciclabile

**BioFill ®** è Performante

## virtuosi di natura

UMBRIA FILLER si impegna da anni a garantire il rispetto delle norme internazionali in materia di
**Qualità, Salute, Sicurezza, Ambiente** e **Processi energetici**.

A tal fine ha conseguito le e Certificazioni per Sistemi di Gestione della Qualità ISO 9001,
ottenuti sin dal 1992, le Certificazioni Ambientali ISO 14001 per stabilimenti e cave, sin dal 1998
e la Certificazione Energetica ISO 50001.

Nel 2025 e 2026 Umbria Filler ha ottenuto, nel campo R&S e Sostenibilità Ambientale le
certificazioni:
**Ok Compost **da TUV Austria per la linea BioFill®  
**Certificazione di Prodotto con contenuto di materiale riciclato/recuperato/sottoprodotto** da ICMQ

**Making patents easier to find**

In patent databases you have to find patents by keyword searching. Xray organizes patents into
categories where patents addressing same problem are already clubbed together. This makes it easy
for you to find patents of your interest.

**Making patents easier to understand**

Xray eliminates legal jargon to make patent language much more easier to understand.

Original Patent Abstract

> A battery system includes: a battery pack including a battery housing and a plurality of battery
> cells accommodated within the battery housing; and a cover element covering an outer side of the
> battery housing. The battery housing has a housing exit at where a venting gas stream exhausted by
> one or more of the battery cells during a thermal runaway exits the battery housing, and the cover
> element covers the housing exit. The cover element forms a venting channel together with the outer
> side of the battery housing such that the venting gas stream exiting the housing exit is received
> and guided by the venting channel along the outer side of the battery housing to a channel exit of
> the venting channel.

> Battery system for electric vehicles that has a unique venting system to safely exhaust gases in
> the event of a battery thermal runaway. The system uses a cover element attached to the battery
> pack housing with a venting channel to redirect and cool the hot gases. The channel has obstacles
> and curves to lengthen the path and increase contact with the cover to extract heat. This prevents
> the hot gases from rapidly exiting the pack and potentially igniting, instead cooling them before
> release.

# Reliable and Innovative Solutions
# for the Global Water Treatment Market

Search for:

### Walchem is a leading manufacturer of online analytical instruments and electronic metering
### pumps. Our mission is to provide the integration of sensor, pump and electronic technologies for
### chemical control. We provide innovative solutions by integrating our instruments, sensors, fluid
### handling and extensive remote data communications technologies.

[[Iwaki America Logo][Iwaki America Logo]][223]
[[Iwaki Air Logo][Iwaki Air Logo]][224]
[[Iwaki Aquatic Logo][Iwaki Aquatic Logo]][225]
[[Water Treatment Controllers][Water Treatment Controllers]][226]

## **Controllers**

### Walchem’s family of cooling tower, boiler, metal finishing, industrial and municipal water
### treatment analytical controllers is designed with a total quality commitment that starts with
### the best design engineering in the industry and continues throughout all stages of the
### manufacturing process.

[Controller Overview][227]
[[Metering Pumps][Metering Pumps]][228]

## **Metering **Pumps

### Walchem and Iwaki joined forces to develop the most innovative and comprehensive metering pump
### product line in the world. Iwaki metering pumps are designed for a broad range of applications,
### and manufactured to the highest quality standards that exceed even the toughest customer
### expectations.

[Metering Pump Overview][229]
[[Sensors][Sensors]][230]

## **Sensors**

### Walchem provides high quality **sensors** for cooling tower, boiler, potable water, and
### wastewater applications. Carefully designed and selected for compatibility with our pumps and
### controllers to enable our customers to provide a complete system solution.

[Sensors Overview][231]
[[Accessories][Accessories]][232]

## **Accessories**

### Walchem provides high quality **accessories** for cooling tower, boiler, potable water, and
### wastewater applications. Carefully designed and selected for compatibility with our pumps and
### controllers to enable our customers to provide a complete system solution.

[Accessories Overview][233]

## Connect to Any Device

### A new cloud-based, water treatment management software tool that amplifies the value of Walchem
### controllers that have Internet access. Simple to set up and use, Walchem Fluent® incorporates
### IoT, Process Automation, Remote Monitoring and Control, and Data Visualization to elevate a
### user’s ability to perform their job efficiently, effectively, and exceptionally. Walchem Fluent®
### will become one of the most valuable resources for managing your water treatment services.

[Learn More!][234]
[Walchem Fluent][Walchem Fluent]

## technologies to deliver reliable and innovative water treatment solutions to the global water
## treatment market.

# Reliable and Innovative Solutions
# for the Global Water Treatment Market

### Walchem is a leading manufacturer of online analytical instruments and electronic metering
### pumps. Our mission is to provide the integration of sensor, pump and electronic technologies for
### chemical control. We provide innovative solutions by integrating our instruments, sensors, fluid
### handling and extensive remote data communications technologies.

[[Iwaki America Logo][Iwaki America Logo]][223]

[[Iwaki Aquatic Logo][Iwaki Aquatic Logo]][225]

## **Controllers**

### Walchem’s family of cooling tower, boiler, metal finishing, industrial and municipal water
### treatment analytical controllers is designed with a total quality commitment that starts with
### the best design engineering in the industry and continues throughout all stages of the
### manufacturing process.

[Controller Overview][227]
[[Metering Pumps][Metering Pumps]][228]

## **Metering **Pumps

### Walchem and Iwaki joined forces to develop the most innovative and comprehensive metering pump
### product line in the world. Iwaki metering pumps are designed for a broad range of applications,
### and manufactured to the highest quality standards that exceed even the toughest customer
### expectations.

[Metering Pump Overview][229]
[[Sensors][Sensors]][230]

## **Sensors**

### Walchem provides high quality **sensors** for cooling tower, boiler, potable water, and
### wastewater applications. Carefully designed and selected for compatibility with our pumps and
### controllers to enable our customers to provide a complete system solution.

[Sensors Overview][231]
[[Accessories][Accessories]][232]

## **Accessories**

### Walchem provides high quality **accessories** for cooling tower, boiler, potable water, and
### wastewater applications. Carefully designed and selected for compatibility with our pumps and
### controllers to enable our customers to provide a complete system solution.

[Accessories Overview][233]

## Connect to Any Device

### A new cloud-based, water treatment management software tool that amplifies the value of Walchem
### controllers that have Internet access. Simple to set up and use, Walchem Fluent® incorporates
### IoT, Process Automation, Remote Monitoring and Control, and Data Visualization to elevate a
### user’s ability to perform their job efficiently, effectively, and exceptionally. Walchem Fluent®
### will become one of the most valuable resources for managing your water treatment services.

[Learn More!][234]
[Walchem Fluent][Walchem Fluent]

### **Zenith Level Overview**

Zenith Level is a consortium of specialized divisions united in their mission to support and advance
the petroleum industry. Our team comprises seasoned professionals with extensive experience in oil
well drilling and production across the Middle East.

### **🔧 Design & Fabrication**

We offer custom engineering and certified manufacturing services, including:
* Certified Frac Tanks (500 BBL capacity).
* Certified Pressurized and Non-Pressurized Oil Tanks.
* Customized Industrial Containers.

### **🛠️ Contracting & Procurement**

Zenith Level provides flexible and reliable solutions for oil site operations:.
* Deployment of experienced oil industry personnel for short- or long-term assignments.
* Procurement of oilfield equipment locally within Iraq or internationally for rental or purchase
(new and used)
* Turnkey supply of oil site equipment along with necessary support personnel.

### **🧠Consulting Services**

We deliver expert consultation for establishing and developing oil well drilling and production
operations in Iraq, tailored to meet local and international standards.

### **⚗️Chemical Supply**

Zenith Level is a leading supplier of high-quality Calcium Carbonate, serving the Iraqi market and
neighboring countries with consistent quality and reliable delivery.
